eligibility_evidence: The IT Network Engineer designs, secures, and maintains a reliable and highly available hybrid network spanning Vivmark Residential's datacenters, corporate offices, residential properties, and public cloud.
Please note: Our current onsite work schedule requires attendance from Monday through Thursday each week, with remote work permitted on Fridays.

Forward thinking, with the ability to assist in the planning of infrastructure requirements two to four years in advance and to adapt quickly to rapidly changing technology and apply it to business needs.
